To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) 6.5 % of students had depression according to the Kutcher criteria, 2) the highest prevalence of depressive symptoms (11.5%) was found in students who were only children and in students of the psychology major, 3) 1.5 % of the students reported suicidal thoughts, and 4) depression was more frequent in women and in students who reported low financial status.
